category_title: Eighth-grade students with ASD showing low academic engagement during math instruction
minimal_context: The student is in their fourth-period eighth-grade general education math class, expected to complete practice problems in a peer-supported group.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time to complete the practice problems with your group. Please use your calculator to solve the first one.

STUDENT: (Does not follow the direction within 10 seconds and begins doodling instead of writing down answers to the problems.)

TUTOR: You need to work on the math. What do you think the answer is?

STUDENT: I'm not doing it. (Pulls out a non-math book and starts reading.)

TUTOR: Please put the book away and try to do the assignment.

STUDENT: (Verbally refuses to do the work again, puts head down on the desk, and fails to complete the assignment during the allotted time.)

options.A: Provide warnings of upcoming transitions between the practice problems and other activities during the math class.
options.B: Provide a checklist guiding the student through the steps of the activity, including reminders to follow directions and ask for help, with a written reinforcer.
options.C: Prompt the student to use a stress ball if they begin doodling instead of completing the practice problems.
options.D: Agree with the student that they are having a rough time completing the practice problems with their group.
